records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our sales are typically higher in our second quarter, which usually includes most of our Anniversary Sale, and in the fourth quarter due to the holidays.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Revenues recognized from our beginning contract liability balance were $112 and $273 for the quarter and nine months ended November 2, 2024 and $114 and $268 for the quarter and nine months ended October 28, 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: As of November 2, 2024, we have an outstanding standby letter of credit of $28 resulting in available short-term borrowing capacity of $772.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: We repurchased no shares of common stock during the nine months ended November 2, 2024, compared with 0.03 shares for $1 at an average purchase price per share of $19.41 during the nine months ended October 28, 2023, and had $438 remaining in share repurchase capacity as of November 2, 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Total Company net sales increased 4.6% versus the same period in fiscal 2023, and total Company comparable sales increased 4.0%.
